# Astray Verify v0.2.2

This release makes contract checks easier to apply consistently in CI and
fixes the release-install path used by the GitHub Action.

## Highlights

- **Per-run check selection.** `astray-verify test --checks
  tools,resources,prompts` now lets a CI workflow verify selected MCP discovery
  surfaces without editing stored fixtures.
- **Working GitHub Action installer.** The Action now downloads the Linux
  binary published by the release workflow, so versioned Action runs install
  the artifact they request.
- **A rebuilt README.** The project now leads with a practical record → commit
  → replay workflow, clear installation instructions, and a ready-to-paste
  Action example.
- **Polished project site.** Current version metadata and refreshed animated
  assets keep the landing page aligned with the release.

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheAstrayDev/astray-verify/main/install.sh | sh
```

Or update your workflow to:

```yaml
uses: TheAstrayDev/astray-verify@v0.2.2
```
